title: Count Triplets with Equal XOR
description: Given an array of positive integers `arr`, count the number of index triplets `(i, j, k)` with `0 <= i < j <= k < arr.length` such that `a == b`, where `a = arr[i] ^ arr[i + 1] ^ ... ^ arr[j - 1]` and `b = arr[j] ^ arr[j + 1] ^ ... ^ arr[k]`.
hints: `a == b` holds if and only if `a ^ b == 0`, meaning the entire subarray `arr[i..k]` has XOR equal to `0` (`pref[i] == pref[k + 1]`).
Every pair `(i, k)` with `pref[i] == pref[k + 1]` contributes `k - i` valid choices of `j`; track the frequency and index-sum of each prefix XOR in hash maps for O(n) time.

examples.explanation: Every even-length subarray of all 1s has XOR 0, yielding 10 valid triplets.
No subarray of [2, 3] has XOR 0, so there are 0 valid triplets.
